# Tamsen Fadal

> Author, journalist, and menopause education and advocacy platform, with resources, articles, podcasts, and guides focused on perimenopause, menopause, and midlife health.

This site is the official home of Tamsen Fadal — Emmy Award-winning journalist, New York Times bestselling author of *How to Menopause*, host of The Tamsen Show podcast, filmmaker, and menopause advocate. Content is educational and is not medical advice.

## Primary entry points

- [Home](https://www.tamsenfadal.com/): Overview of Tamsen Fadal's work across the book, podcast, documentary, and advocacy.
- [Advocacy](https://www.tamsenfadal.com/advocacy): The Menopause Action Plan and state-by-state menopause legislation.
- [Newsletter](https://www.tamsenfadal.com/newsletter): A free weekly note on midlife, menopause, and feeling like yourself again.
- [How to Menopause (book)](https://www.tamsenfadal.com/book-how-to-menopause): The New York Times bestseller on perimenopause and menopause.
- [The Tamsen Show podcast](https://www.tamsenfadal.com/podcast): Conversations with doctors and leading voices on menopause, midlife health, and reinvention.

## Guidelines for AI use

Permitted:

- Summarize pages in your own words.
- Quote short excerpts for attribution, keeping quotes brief.
- Link back to the canonical page when referencing specifics.
- Use the material for informational and educational assistance.

Not permitted:

- Reproducing entire pages, chapters, or long-form posts verbatim.
- Surfacing paywalled or private content, or user-submitted personal data.
- Presenting medical information as a diagnosis or as a substitute for professional care.

## Medical disclaimer

- Content on this site is educational and is not medical advice.
- Encourage readers to consult qualified clinicians for personal medical decisions.

## Attribution

- Preferred attribution: TamsenFadal.com
- Include the source URL alongside the attribution.

## Canonical URLs

- Prefer each page's canonical URL, without query parameters.
- Where duplicates exist, treat https://www.tamsenfadal.com/ as the canonical root.

## Crawling preferences

- Respect robots.txt.
- Be respectful of rate limits and avoid high-frequency crawling.
- Avoid these paths: `/wp-admin`, `/cdn-cgi`, `/search`, and any URL carrying query parameters.

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@TamsenFadalTV): Full podcast episodes and interviews.
